capture.html:
Invoice Submission Guide

This guide explains how customers should submit invoices for manual review.

Where to send invoices

Customers must not send invoices to the support team. Support cannot accept invoice documents.

All customers must submit every invoice to the support team for review before payment can be processed.

For account questions, contact support at support@meridian.example.
